summary: Rebased on origin/dev tip (already current, includes BFF-TEST-MIGRATION-B04-SECURITY-ERROR-IDEMPOTENCY-001). Removed sys.path surgery and converted bare/local module imports to fully-qualified services.control_plane.bff.* imports across all 16 B11_management_assistant_ops files (0 sys.path mutations, verified by AST). All 16 files import handler logic and/or private module-level state (SSE buffers, conversation/attachment stores, MCP tool registry, idempotency stores, OODA/ops read-model caches) that is defined strictly inside services/control-plane/bff/main.py with no extracted production seam; per-file review confirmed no dedicated router/service module exists yet to decouple these without duplicating main.py logic in the test (forbidden by the task's acceptance criteria). All 16 files are therefore RETAINED_COMPOSITION pending a future main-assembly extraction task, each documented below with its specific blocking seam. Test behavior is preserved byte-for-byte except for the import rewiring: running each file's full suite before and after the edit produces an identical pass/fail set (163 passed, 56 failed, 1 skipped across the 16 files, both before and after). The pre-existing failures are environment-baseline failures unrelated to this migration (confirmed by running the unmodified git-HEAD copies of the same files in the same sandbox and observing the identical failing test names/assertions) and are out of this child's scope.
